provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled energy-intensity Raman thermometry: R_j=g*((nu_laser+nu_j)/(nu_laser-nu_j))^4*exp(-c2*nu_j/T), with one unknown positive T and one unknown wavelength-independent relative response gain g. Ratios refer to energy intensity rather than photon count; all shifts are positive and below laser wavenumber. No resonance change, mixture temperature or band-dependent response.
analysis_policy: Infer T and g using ONLY the first two bands. Predict the third ratio without refitting. The single-band shortcut fixes g=1and uses the first band with the same fourth-power optical factor. The identifiability question removes the other bands and any gain calibration.
scope: A controlled spectroscopic inverse model, not a measured temperature, a physical heating protocol or a chemical reaction recommendation.
